from pathlib import Path
import gi
from gi.repository import Gio
app=Gio.DesktopAppInfo.new("isycode-ide.desktop")
assert app and app.get_display_name()=="ISyCode IDE"
icon=app.get_icon()
assert isinstance(icon,Gio.FileIcon)
assert icon.get_file().get_path()=="/home/danny/.local/share/icons/hicolor/256x256/apps/isycode-ide.png"
try:
    old=Gio.DesktopAppInfo.new("isycode.desktop")
except TypeError:
    old=None
assert old is None
assert Path("/home/danny/.local/bin/isycode").is_file()
assert not Path("/home/danny/Applications/ISyCode.AppImage").exists()
print("GNOME/GIO: neon cat icon resolved; old GUI absent; TUI preserved.")
